description: Native Kotlin + Jetpack Compose rewrite of the Pulse realtime status & messaging app. Same Supabase backend as the web/PWA client; no WebView.

tech_stack.build: AGP 8.13.0, Gradle wrapper (JDK 17 local / 21 CI), Compose compiler plugin

backend_contract.notes: Shares the exact same Supabase project as the web app (hrbophzmwuhmzyibjuge.supabase.co default URL). Google OAuth client IDs must match the Firebase android client; web client ID goes in strings.xml for ID token sign-in.

feature_parity.realtime_dms: sender + recipient both receive postgres_changes inserts
feature_parity.read_receipts: double ticks synced via realtime + fallback receipt-sync poll
feature_parity.status_updates: emoji + photo/video composer, live dashboard refresh
feature_parity.username: mandatory onboarding, rename only in Settings, 2x/week cooldown
feature_parity.push_notifications: data-only FCM handled locally for DM + status notifications

build_and_ci.ci: .github/workflows/build-android.yml — assembleDebug on push to main, uploads app-debug.apk artifact (30 days)
manual_steps: Place Firebase google-services.json in app/ (package com.pulse.statusapp)
Replace REPLACE_WITH_WEB_CLIENT_ID in app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml with Google OAuth web client ID
Enable Google provider in Supabase Auth with the Android + Web OAuth client IDs
Ensure the Pulse SQL schema + edge functions are deployed to the Supabase project (from web repo supabase_setup.sql)
build_and_ci.env_override: BuildConfig.SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_ANON_KEY via -P gradle properties (secrets in CI)

next_steps: First CI build — fix any compile warnings surfaced by AGP/Kotlin 2.4
Smoke-test on device: auth, realtime chat, receipts, push
Move Supabase keys fully to BuildConfig + remove fallback URL for release
Add release signing config + Play Store / direct-download release build
